title: Split the bill
description: splitBill(totalCents, people) splits a bill fairly without losing or inventing a cent. Everyone pays the same rounded-down share, and the leftover cents go one each to the first people: splitBill(1000, 3) is [334, 333, 333]. balances(totalCents, paid) tells how much each person still owes (negative means they get money back).
hint: The shares must always add up to the total. Try 1000 split 3 ways, and 1000 split 6 ways. Then check the sign of balances.
